arguments.title: Correct text placement in pixels
arguments.code: import {get_timeline,edit_timeline,validate_timeline,preview_timeline_frame} from "@nodetool-ai/sandbox-nodetool/timelines";const id="83a5dfb0f663";const state=await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});const ops=state.timeline.clips.filter(c=>c.mediaType==="text").map(c=>({op:"set_clip_params",target:c.id,transform:{position:{x:0,y:c.name==="Title"?-160:270}}}));await edit_timeline({timeline_id:id,ops});const preview=await preview_timeline_frame({timeline_id:id,times_ms:[1000,6500,12000],sheet:true,width:640});const validation=await validate_timeline({timeline_id:id});const finalState=await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});return {preview,validation,finalState};
